de.invite_limit: You can create up to five requests per day. Try again tomorrow.
de.card_help:
Edit: /cardname nickname · /cardbio bio
Find songs: /cardsearch song title
Share: /cardshare · Hide: /cardhide
Delete: /carddelete
/cardimage · /invitations · /pickfavorites
de.card_image_private: Your image preview. The card is still private. Creating a link makes the selected fields visible; an image you forward cannot be recalled.
de.invite_scope: Only the selected songs shown here are included. Private ratings, listening history and contacts stay private. The other person must agree too. Invitations expire after 48 hours or the card link expiry. Editing or hiding either card withdraws consent.
de.card_image_download: Get full-size image in the bot with /cardimage.
de.social_report_reason: Choose a reason. The note is included for operator review. Reports over 90 days old are removed on the next visit to swaps or interaction settings. Reporting does not automatically block this person.
de.social_sent: In their inbox · no reaction yet
de.social_notice_pick: A friend sent you a song. Open your inbox to see it.
de.social_block_done: Blocked. Consent and pending swaps were withdrawn. Unblocking does not restore them.
de.social_waiting: Waiting for you in your inbox
de.card_stale: This song choice has expired. Search again and select a result.
de.card_preview_only: Preview only. Nothing is saved or shared.
de.social_removed: Exchange removed. Copies of delivered messages cannot be recalled. Saved songs and explicit ratings are separate.
de.onboard_done: Your five favorites are ready. Choose a nickname with /cardname, then preview your image with /cardimage. These selections did not create ratings.
de.card_private: Private · only you can see this card
de.g2_text: Tap Get song to return to this bot. The bot finds the audio and asks you to choose if there are multiple versions.
de.invite_state_consented: Both agreed to these selected songs. You can compare them or send a song.
de.social_notice_saved: Your song pick was saved. Open the exchange for details.
de.card_full: Your card already has five songs. Remove one first.
de.social_choose: Choose one of the favorites covered by your agreement. You can add a short note before sending.
de.invite_invalid: Invalid invitation. Open the shared card again.
de.social_only_you: On your card, not in their selected favorites
de.ux_home_intro: Try a song below. Get song sends the audio to your Telegram chat; rating is optional.
de.ux_search_intro: Find a song, choose the right version, then tap Get song to receive it in Telegram.
de.ux_card_intro: Your music, in a card. Choose up to five songs, then share it with a friend.
de.ux_swaps_intro: Songs you and a friend send each other. Save a pick, love it, or send one back.
de.ux_connections_intro: Compare the songs on your cards after you both agree. Your other ratings stay private.
de.ux_channels_intro: Connect a Telegram music channel to use its songs for recommendations. This is optional.
de.ux_search_empty: Which song are you looking for?
de.ux_search_example: Enter a song or artist above. Try “Beach House — Space Song”.
de.ux_first_song: Start with one song that feels like you. Search below to add it.
de.ux_card_next: Add songs here. Sharing stays off until you create a link.
de.ux_share_intro: Review your card above, then create a link. Your friend can ask to compare tastes.
de.ux_connections_next: Build your card and share its link. When a friend opens it and you both agree, the comparison appears here.
de.ux_swaps_empty: Your first song exchange starts with a friend
de.ux_swaps_next: Open a taste comparison, then choose “Send a song”. Songs you send and receive will appear here.
de.ux_card_live: Your link is active. Saved changes update what your friend sees.
de.ux_save_love: Save keeps this pick under My card. Love is your rating of the song.
de.ux_no_overlap: These cards do not share a song or artist yet. Send each other a pick to discover something new.
de.flow_swipe: Swipe the card up or down; swipe sideways for tabs.
de.flow_no_more: No more picks in this batch. Try Search or come back later.
de.flow_delivery_waiting: Continue in the bot chat to request this song.
de.flow_delivery_choice: Choose a version in the bot chat.
de.flow_delivery_failed: Could not send. Open the bot chat to retry.
de.flow_delivery_cancelled: Request cancelled in the bot chat.
de.flow_delivery_uncertain: Delivery is not confirmed. Check the bot chat.
de.flow_delivery_unavailable: Could not check delivery. Check the bot chat.
de.flow_delivery_preview: Preview only. No song request was sent.
de.a1_publish_requirements: Save a nickname and choose at least one song before publishing.
de.a1_exchange_clear: Nothing waiting here. Your other exchanges are in the next tab.
de.home_swipe: Swipe up for the next song. Pull down on the first card for unseen picks.
de.owl_label: Owl mascot, tap for a tip
de.owl_tip_0: Swipe the card up or down
